oneLine: KPI Green Energy acquires Alfanar Energy and Netra Wind for Rs 2,410 crore.

sources.title: KPI Green Energy Enters Binding Offer To Acquire Alfanar Energy And Netra Wind For ₹2,410 Crore
KPI Green Energy to acquire 507.9 MW operational wind assets in Gujarat for Rs 2,410 crore

synopsis: KPI Green Energy has entered into a binding offer to acquire a 100% equity stake in Alfanar Energy Private Limited and Netra Wind Private Limited for a total transaction value of 2,410 crore rupees. This acquisition adds 507.9 MW of wind power generation capacity, marking a strategic expansion for KPI Green Energy from a solar-focused business into an integrated hybrid utility platform. The transaction involves purchasing the entirety of both target companies, thereby scaling up the buyer's clean energy base and positioning it as a diversified power producer. The report does not disclose named individual sellers, advisers, or specific dates for final financial closing beyond the announcement made in September 2026.
